entries.title: Recent improvements
lines: Rare spider surprise: optional, enabled for new runs.
Random attacks every 5–30 gameplay minutes, including bosses.
Music information in the tracker and faster state reads.

entries.title: Music shuffle and direct exits
lines: Optional shared music pool: 45 level and boss tracks.
Music choices travel with the seed; default is OFF.
Direct room exits keep arrival and reset protection.

entries.title: Recent improvements
lines: Animated intro scenery and clearer menu text.
Mouse and keyboard menus in five languages.
Safer settings, resets, stage splits and debug reports.

entries.title: Randomized native intro
lines: Gentle clouds, stars and desert dust behind the menu.
Theme-aware shading keeps text readable and steady.
Original platform shapes, timing and seeds stay intact.

entries.title: Menu navigation and shot-style controls
lines: Hover highlights choices; arrows move without changing settings.
Confirm with Enter or click. Tab, Shift+Tab and page keys navigate.
Choose timed, spot, death or combined shot-style changes directly.

entries.title: Stability and diagnostic reports
lines: Protected transitions with automatic pause release.
Automatic error reports and per-spot test evidence.
Completed saves open their run results directly.

entries.title: Random World in two parts
lines: Choose both sections separately in Advanced.
Crossing into part 2 now completes part 1.
Arrival and reset protection; existing seeds keep their rules.

entries.title: Kid Icarus and safer resets
lines: Kid Icarus: approach, miniboss and final section.
Boss completion waits for every fragment and the open exit.
Reset-time memory reads retry safely; existing runs keep their rules.

entries.title: Five UI languages
lines: Automatic language detection.
English, German, Russian, Spanish and Japanese.
Shared seeds keep the same rules.

entries.title: Your rules, your pace
lines: Choose shot timers in minutes and seconds.
Standard, Chaos and Training presets.
Active extras in the live tracker.

entries.title: Runs you can inspect
lines: Rule snapshots protect existing runs.
Run results and seed replay.
Debug reports explain transitions.

entries.title: Shot styles and comfort
lines: Random shot changes by time, death or spot.
Optional shorter chest animations.
Pop-ups and mouse ghost disabled by default.

entries.title: Native randomizer
lines: Legacy pixel randomizer retired.
Shared seeds include every extra.
Existing runs keep their own rules.

entries.title: Clearer menus
lines: Save details next to the slot numbers.
Updates in the original message window.
Online entry removed from the menu.

entries.title: Minibosses and transitions
lines: Kracko, Ryu passage and Gravitron added.
Position checks without screen pixels.
Ridley and Questionmark intro protection.
